text.tspan: Share of children in employment vs. GDP per capita 2016
Share of children ages 7-14 involved in economic activity for at least one hour in the reference week of the
corresponding survey. GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

tspan.tspan: International Labour Organization, UNICEF, and World Bank (2026); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026); UN, World
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2016 is unavailable, the value from the closest year
